g.text: quincy said u wanted to talk to me? <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

Yeah. I. I don't know how else to say this, but I - I have feelings for you.
oh. do u really mean that?
I really do. I've been losing sleep over it, honestly. :{

but... if i'm being honest i have really missed u... and quincy did say u were really sorry...

are u sure you want to give this another try?
